# demo-typescript

A demo.

## Development

Install [prek](https://prek.j178.dev/installation/), then the hooks:

```sh
prek install
```

TypeScript uses [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/), which installs the Node.js and pnpm
versions pinned in `package.json`.
